facts.text: I have a PNG illustration of a spooky castle.
I want to join an image of my niece dressed as a witch with the spooky castle illustration using artificial intelligence.
I manually selected my niece's image using the software's selection tool.
I applied a layer mask to remove the background from my niece's image.
I pasted my niece's image onto the castle illustration.
The final result was not satisfactory because the lighting and colors between my niece's image and the illustration did not match well.
I want detailed step by step instructions to perform these techniques using GIMP.
I asked in which moments I should merge down, if any.
